name: audiogen-cpp
description: ACE-Step text-to-music engine in pure C++/ggml, from qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp's engines/audiogen. This pin (master b965cba0, PR #122) runs the ACE-Step LM and the FSQ detokenizer on Metal instead of pinning them to the CPU, so on Apple every stage of the pipeline is on the GPU. The two reasons the pin recorded no longer hold, and one was never true for the model that ships: the 'Metal produces empty or garbage logits' result was measured against the 1.7B LM, whose activations reach ~1.9e6 and overflow fp16, while the shipping 0.6B LM peaks at 1.02e5 and only in the final layer, which never reaches an fp16-staged mul_mm because the head runs on a single token; and the Q8_0 -> F32 CPY the detokenizer needs has had a Metal kernel for some time, the stage had simply never been re-run there. The pin is also an accuracy improvement, not merely a speed one: CPU is not ground truth for a quantized model, since ggml's CPU matmul quantizes activations to Q8_1 internally, so the old placement forced the less accurate path. Measured against an F32-dequantized reference rather than against CPU, Metal reproduces the F32 argmax trajectory exactly where CPU Q8_0 diverges at token 0, is closer to F32 in all 28 LM layers (3.18e-3 vs 9.60e-2 at the last layer), and is closer at every pipeline stage; the detokenizer is cosine 0.99998939 against CPU. Placement stays an allowlist rather than a denylist, so an unmeasured backend keeps the CPU placement and cannot silently regress generated audio, and the policy now lives in a separate stage_placement.h covered by test-acestep-units (allowlist, both the MTL and Metal registry names, CPU fallback, and ACESTEP_LM_* / ACESTEP_DETOK_* override precedence). End to end this is 5.75x on an Apple M5 and 6.24x on an iPhone 17 (A19), with the A19 render byte-identical to the Mac Metal render. The ggml-speech floor is a hard dependency rather than a courtesy bump: the FSQ detokenizer casts a quantized special-tokens tensor to F32 in-graph, and the addon's default DiT variant is acestep-v15-turbo-Q4_K_M, so moving that stage onto Metal is exactly what makes ggml_cast(Q4_K -> F32) reachable there -- against an older ggml-speech it aborts with "unsupported op 'CPY'". The 2026-08-04 floor closes that hole (ggml PR #51), which also makes Metal im2col dispatch-efficient, and carries the Vulkan equivalent from PR #47, the Adreno OpenCL ops from PRs #49 / #50, and the Vulkan snake / col2im_1d kernels and GGML_PREC_F32 matmul paths from PRs #45 / #46.
